## Analyzer Architecture Summary

llm-d-inference-scheduler is a Kubernetes component. managing 2 CRD(s)\: InferenceModelRewrite, InferenceObjective. watching 5 resource type(s). Dockerfile EXPOSE ports\: 5557, 8080, 9002, 9003, 9090. connecting to external services\: grpc, redis. runtime dependencies\: Redis, pod-name. with 2098 operator config constants (16 image references, 6 env vars). exposing 156 Prometheus metrics. with 5 ingress route(s). Python k8s client with 1 API call(s). kustomize overlays\: config/crd. references components\: vllm (adapter).
